profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Creative, curious, and conscientious software engineer since 2016. Working on open-source software at the Natural Capital Alliance (formerly Natural Capital Project) since 2024. Depth of front-end development expertise coupled with breadth in computer science fundamentals and background in education and the humanities.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing open-source software—including InVEST—to help researchers and policymakers evaluate ecosystem services. Python, NumPy, GDAL, React, Electron, and more.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description: Built websites, web apps, and UI component libraries for clients in a wide range of industries, including consumer goods (e-commerce), insurance, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and telecommunications. Technologies include HTML5, CSS, SCSS, CSS Modules, JavaScript, TypeScript, jQuery, React, Angular, ngRx, Jest, nx, and more.

positions.title: Web and Mobile Application Developer
positions.description: Built and maintained a variety of custom websites, web apps, and hybrid mobile apps. As a full stack developer I contributed production code in HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript, jQuery, TypeScript/Angular, PHP/Phalcon, and Python. My primary area of focus was on building user interfaces and data visualizations in Angular (2+) with TypeScript and SCSS.

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description: Completed a full-time, six-week internship that included training in languages, frameworks, CMSes, and tools typical of Riafox projects. Became certified in HubSpot template development, built a custom WordPress site, contributed TypeScript code to an Angular 2/Ionic hybrid mobile app in production, and researched and built proof-of-concept for Ionic/Cordova plugins.

positions.title: Student / Developer in Training
positions.description: I am a graduate of the 12-week immersive Full Stack Web Development course at BoiseCodeWorks, where I gained hands-on experience with front-end and back-end languages and tools including HTML5, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery, AngularJS, Node.js, Express, JSData, C#, .NET Core, .NET MVC, Git, and Firebase.

positions.title: Editor and Software Tester
positions.description: Worked with web development team in a QA/QC role. Besides alpha-testing newly developed e-courses, I also prepared annual course maintenance reports on accessibility compliance, browser compatibility, hyperlink functionality, site traffic, and recommended revisions for all active e-courses. Edited a wide variety of texts including technical reports, grant proposals, and website copy.

company.name: Eppley Institute for Parks and Public Lands

positions.title: Admissions Specialist, Data Analyst, Writer
positions.description: Collaborated with developers to customize database functionality in order to improve accuracy and efficiency. Processed thousands of admissions documents in a graduate admissions office. Retrieved admissions data from multiple databases. Wrote process guides and reference documents for training coworkers and successors.

positions.title: Admissions Assistant
positions.description: Helped the Office of Admissions to transition to a paperless system. Scanned and organized thousands of admissions documents in a custom web-based application management system. Retrieved and analyzed applicant data.

company.name: Eastman School of Music, University of Rochester

positions.title: Spanish Language Instructor
positions.description: Instructor of record for an intermediate-level Spanish class of approximately 25 undergraduate students. Taught all class sessions and developed syllabus, lesson plans, and exams.

positions.title: Program Coordinator, Center for Latin American Studies
positions.description: Coordinated events, developed publicity materials, managed student records, gathered data for grant applications, and maintained website.
